title: REFINE: A Multi-Agent LLM Approach for Evidence-Guided Code Refactoring
abstract: arXiv:2608.23611v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer new opportunities for automated code refactoring. However, generated changes must reduce targeted quality problems without introducing new issues or altering behaviour-relevant code structures. We introduce REFINE (Refactoring with Evidence-aware Flow for Integrated ageNtic Execution), a tool-agnostic, evidence-aware multi-agent approach for generating Java file-level refactoring candidates. REFINE combines static-analysis-guided smell identification, smell-informed planning, LLM-based transformation, automated re-analysis, preservation checks, and structured reporting.   We evaluate REFINE on 450 Java files from 15 open-source systems, producing 1,350 model-pass outputs using OpenAI GPT-5.5, Google Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, and Anthropic Claude Opus 4.8. REFINE reduces detected code smells by 68.26%, 72.79%, and 68.49% across the three configurations, respectively, with the strongest reductions observe

translated_title: REFINE：一种基于多智能体LLM的证据引导代码重构方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23611v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：大型语言模型（LLMs）为自动化代码重构提供了新的机遇。然而，生成的更改必须减少目标质量问题，而不引入新问题或改变与行为相关的代码结构。我们引入了REFINE（基于证据感知流程的集成智能体执行重构），这是一种工具无关、证据感知的多智能体方法，用于生成Java文件级别的重构候选方案。REFINE结合了静态分析引导的气味识别、气味知情的规划、基于LLM的转换、自动重新分析、保留检查和结构化报告。我们在来自15个开源系统的450个Java文件上评估了REFINE，使用OpenAI GPT-5.5、Google Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview和Anthropic Claude Opus 4.8生成了1,350个模型通过输出。REFINE在三种配置中分别减少了68.26%、72.79%和68.49%的检测到的代码气味，其中最强的减少效果被观察到。
tldr: REFINE是一种新颖的多智能体LLM框架，通过结合静态分析、证据感知规划和保留检查，在Java项目中显著减少代码气味（最高达72.79%），同时确保不引入新问题或改变行为相关结构。
en_tdlr: REFINE is a novel multi-agent LLM framework that significantly reduces code smells (up to 72.79%) in Java projects by integrating static analysis, evidence-aware planning, and preservation checks, while ensuring no new issues are introduced or behavior-relevant structures are altered.
